title: 2022 CODATA: Newtonian constant of gravitation is 6.674 30 × 10^−11
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives Newtonian constant of gravitation as 6.674 30 × 10^−11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2, with uncertainty 0.000 15 × 10^−11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, gives Newtonian constant of gravitation as 6.674 30 × 10^−11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2, with uncertainty 0.000 15 × 10^−11 m^3 kg^-1 s^-2. The row is not marked exact. This is G, the Newtonian constant of gravitation, in the 2022 recommended values. The uncertainty is large next to the other constants in this pack: the listing does not mark it exact.
